service.name: strategy-server
service.description: Emergent Strategy platform backend — EPF strategy authoring, AIM lifecycle orchestration, and ripple coherence, exposed over MCP and a web UI.

tool_categories.name: core
tool_categories.description: Always visible — routing, instance lookup, batch management, search

tool_categories.name: strategy
tool_categories.description: Strategy reads — vision, personas, competitive position, roadmap, coverage analysis

tool_categories.name: features
tool_categories.description: Feature CRUD, definitions, relationships, dependencies, artifacts

tool_categories.name: authoring
tool_categories.description: Foundation writes — north star, formula, roadmap, value model

tool_categories.name: work
tool_categories.description: Work packages — SOW contracts, footprint, status transitions (execution handover)

tool_categories.name: aim
tool_categories.description: AIM lifecycle — LRA, assessment, calibration, cycles, assumptions

tool_categories.name: ripple
tool_categories.description: Coherence engine — signals, equilibrium, convergence, ripple config

tool_categories.name: semantic
tool_categories.description: Semantic graph — contradictions, neighbors, what-if scenarios

tool_categories.name: validation
tool_categories.description: Validation, content readiness, fix plans, export

tool_categories.name: admin
tool_categories.description: Workspace, org, instance, version, and GitHub sync management

tool_categories.name: knowledge
tool_categories.description: EPF knowledge base — schemas, templates, agents, skills, wizards

tool_categories.name: packs
tool_categories.description: Skill packs, apps, skill authoring and execution

tool_categories.name: observability
tool_categories.description: Activity stream, skill runs, LLM usage, heartbeat, proposals

tools.name: acknowledge_heartbeat
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to mark a heartbeat signal as seen. Acknowledged signals are excluded from future list_heartbeat_signals results.

tools.name: acknowledge_signal
tools.description: USE WHEN you want to mark a signal as seen without resolving it.

tools.name: activate_instance
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to set a strategy instance as the active one for its workspace.

tools.name: add_relationship
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to create a relationship between two artifacts (contributes_to, depends_on, tests_assumption, enables, in_tracks). Stages a mutation; call commit_batch after review.

batch_id.description: Optional batch UUID to group with other staged mutations

relationship.description: Relationship type: contributes_to, depends_on, tests_assumption, enables, in_tracks, implements

target_type.description: Target artifact type (e.g. value_path, feature, assumption). Auto-inferred when possible.

tools.name: aim_get_run
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to check the current status of an orchestrated AIM cycle run — shows step progress, current batch_id waiting for review, and overall run status (pending, running, awaiting_human, completed, failed, aborted).

tools.name: aim_start_cycle
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to start a fully-orchestrated AIM cycle for an instance. Runs all four steps (draft assessment, draft calibration, apply calibration, snapshot) in sequence, pausing at each step for human batch review. Returns run_id for progress polling with aim_get_run. Returns ErrAlreadyActive (409) if a run is already in progress.

tools.name: apply_aim_calibration
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to apply a committed calibration decision to READY artifacts. Stages targeted patches (strategy formula, north star, roadmap) for human review.

tools.name: approve_cycle_proposal
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to approve a pending AIM cycle proposal — approves the proposal and immediately starts an orchestrated AIM cycle run.

tools.name: approve_work_package
tools.description: [work] USE WHEN a proposed work package is signed off. Transitions status proposed → approved (an approved work package becomes eligible for scheduling). Returns batch_id.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: archive_feature
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft archival of a feature. Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: archive_instance
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to archive a strategy instance and discard its staged mutations.

tools.name: assign_workspace_to_org
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to reassign a workspace to a different organisation. Requires org_admin role on the target org.

tools.name: batch_create_artifacts
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to stage multiple new artifacts in a single batch — e.g. creating several features or definition files at once. All mutations share one batch_id. Returns batch_id for confirmation.

artifacts.description: JSON array of artifacts to stage. Each item: {"artifact_type":"feature","artifact_key":"fd-042","payload":{...}}

tools.name: check_content_readiness
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to score the content quality of an artifact — checks for presence of recommended fields and returns a 0-100 readiness score. Omit artifact_key to check all features in the instance. Returns a verdict in structuredContent, where every missing field is a WARNING finding — readiness never reports `ok: false`, because which score counts as failing is your policy, not the server's. Gate on counts.warning or findings.

artifact_key.description: Optional artifact key. If omitted, scores all features.

tools.name: coherence_check
tools.description: USE WHEN you need a full-graph coherence analysis — orphaned paths, untested assumptions, stale artifacts.

tools.name: commit_batch
tools.description: USE WHEN the user has confirmed a staged change and you need to commit the batch.

batch_id.description: Batch UUID returned by a write tool

tools.name: commit_scenario
tools.description: USE WHEN you want to promote a what-if scenario's mutations into a staging batch for review and commit.

tools.name: create_aim_report
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to create a post-launch AIM assessment report — captures OKR progress, assumption validations, and strategic insights for a completed cycle. Stages a mutation; call commit_batch after review.

batch_id.description: Optional batch UUID

payload.description: Assessment report JSON payload conforming to assessment_report_schema

tools.name: create_feature
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft a new feature definition. Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: create_lra
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to create a new Living Reality Assessment (LRA) artifact for an instance — captures the current strategic context before a launch or AIM cycle. Stages a mutation; call commit_batch after review.

batch_id.description: Optional batch UUID to group with other staged mutations

payload.description: LRA JSON payload conforming to living_reality_assessment_schema

tools.name: create_org
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to create a new organisation. The caller becomes the org admin.

tools.name: create_work_package
tools.description: [work] USE WHEN you need to draft a new work package (SOW contract). Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to register a new workspace for a GitHub organisation. Every workspace must belong to an org.

org_id.description: Organisation UUID that will own this workspace

tools.name: defer_cycle_proposal
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to snooze a pending AIM cycle proposal. The heartbeat will not create a new proposal until the snooze period expires.

tools.name: delete_instance
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to permanently delete a strategy instance and all its data (mutations, artifacts, relationships, versions, signals). This is irreversible — use archive_instance instead if you only want to hide the instance.

tools.name: delete_workspace
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to permanently delete a workspace and all its strategy instances. This is irreversible — all instances, artifacts, mutations, and history in the workspace will be removed.

tools.name: describe_batch
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to attach your agent identity and a human-readable description to a staged batch before presenting it for review.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent authoring this batch, e.g. pathfinder

batch_id.description: Batch UUID to annotate

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this batch changes

ripple_chain.description: Optional: JSON array of artifact keys showing the propagation chain

root_cause_key.description: Optional: artifact key that triggered this ripple batch

tools.name: describe_pack_format
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to understand the pack, skill, or app YAML format for authoring a new pack. Returns schemas and a complete example.

tools.name: detect_contradictions
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to scan for structural contradictions in the strategy graph.

tools.name: diff_versions
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to compare two strategy versions. Returns which artifacts were added, removed, or changed between the two versions.

tools.name: discard_batch
tools.description: USE WHEN the user has declined a staged change and you need to discard the batch.

batch_id.description: Batch UUID returned by a write tool

tools.name: discard_scenario
tools.description: USE WHEN you want to discard a what-if scenario branch without merging it. The scenario and its mutations are permanently removed.

tools.name: dismiss_signal
tools.description: USE WHEN a detected misalignment is intentional and should not be flagged again.

tools.name: draft_aim_assessment
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft a pre-populated assessment report from live roadmap OKRs and assumption relationships. Stages a batch for human review.

tools.name: draft_aim_calibration
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft a calibration memo with a suggested decision (persevere/pivot/pull_the_plug) based on a committed assessment report. Stages a batch for human review.

tools.name: evaluate_scenario
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to assess the impact of a what-if scenario on the strategy graph.

tools.name: explain_value_path
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see which value model paths a specific feature contributes to (its contributes_to edges).

tools.name: export_feature_yaml
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the YAML representation of a single feature artifact — returns {rel_path, content} ready to write to the EPF directory.

tools.name: export_instance_yaml
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to export all committed artifacts for an instance as EPF-structured YAML files. Returns a list of {rel_path, content} entries matching the EPF directory layout (READY/, FIRE/, AIM/).

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: USE WHEN you need a structured Markdown strategy report for an instance — includes artifact inventory, value propositions, value path coverage, and assumptions under test.

tools.name: find_instance_by_repo
tools.description: USE WHEN you know a GitHub repository and need the strategy instance(s) it uses. Searches both the instance's home repo and registered consumer repos. Returns a list — a repo can legitimately map to more than one instance.

base_path.description: Optional path within the repo where the instance is mounted, e.g. docs/EPF/_instances/emergent. Omit to match any mount point.

tools.name: generate_ripple_batch
tools.description: USE WHEN you need context to generate draft updates for active ripple signals.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full agent definition (metadata + prompt) for a specific EPF agent to activate it or understand its capabilities.

tools.name: get_agent_for_task
tools.description: USE FIRST to route any task to the right tool or agent. Returns direct_tool or agent recommendation.

task_description.description: Natural-language description of what you want to do

tools.name: get_aim_summary
tools.description: USE WHEN you need an overview of the AIM phase for an instance — lists all LRAs, assessment reports, and trigger configs with counts.

tools.name: get_assumptions
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see all strategic assumptions and which features test each one (tests_assumption relationships).

tools.name: get_competitive_position
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the competitive analysis for a strategy instance.

tools.name: get_convergence_history
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see past convergence loop runs for an instance.

damping_reason.description: Filter by damping reason: max_iterations, change_budget_exceeded, anchor_drift, emergency_brake

tools.name: get_coverage_analysis
tools.description: USE WHEN you need a matrix of which value model paths are covered by which features — useful for gap analysis or roadmap review.

tools.name: get_definition
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full YAML template for a specific canonical track definition. Use list_definitions to find the path first.

tools.name: get_equilibrium_status
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the current equilibrium score and coherence breakdown for an instance.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to read a single evidence item by its artifact key.

tools.name: get_feature
tools.description: USE WHEN you need full details and value model for a single feature.

tools.name: get_feature_dependencies
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full dependency graph for an instance — all depends_on and enables edges between features.

tools.name: get_installed_skill
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full definition of a specific skill available to an instance, including its prompt, source, and execution mode.

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: USE WHEN you need details and health status for a specific instance.

tools.name: get_llm_usage
tools.description: USE WHEN you need aggregated LLM token usage by skill name for an instance — useful for cost tracking and budgeting.

since.description: ISO 8601 date — include only runs started after this date

until.description: ISO 8601 date — include only runs started before this date

tools.name: get_lra
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to read the current state of a Living Reality Assessment artifact.

tools.name: get_mutation
tools.description: USE WHEN you need details for a specific mutation record by ID.

tools.name: get_neighbors
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the semantic graph neighbourhood of a strategy node — connected artifacts and edge types.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: USE WHEN you need full details of an installed pack including all skill names and apps.

tools.name: get_persona_details
tools.description: USE WHEN you need deep persona detail including pain points, jobs-to-be-done, and behavioral patterns. Returns parsed persona data from strategy_foundations.

persona_name.description: Optional persona name filter. Omit to return all personas.

tools.name: get_personas
tools.description: USE WHEN you need target personas and their pain points for a strategy instance.

tools.name: get_phase_artifacts
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to know which artifact types belong to a specific EPF phase (READY, FIRE, or AIM). Returns artifact types with descriptions, schema files, and template paths.

phase.description: EPF phase: READY, FIRE, or AIM

tools.name: get_product_vision
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the north star vision for a strategy instance.

tools.name: get_ripple_config
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the current ripple configuration for instance.

tools.name: get_roadmap
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full roadmap recipe for a strategy instance.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full JSON Schema for a specific EPF artifact type to validate content or understand required fields.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full skill definition (metadata + prompt) for a specific EPF skill to execute a guided authoring workflow.

tools.name: get_skill_run
tools.description: USE WHEN you need full detail of a specific skill run — includes per-chunk timing, token counts, validation errors, and trigger context.

tools.name: get_strategic_context_for_feature
tools.description: USE WHEN you need full strategic context for a single feature: its artifact payload plus all indexed relationships grouped by type (contributes_to, tests_assumptions, depends_on, enables, in_tracks).

tools.name: get_strategy_context
tools.description: USE WHEN you need full strategic context: vision, personas, and competitive position.

tools.name: get_sync_state
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to check the current sync state between the server and GitHub without performing any import or export. Returns in_sync/server_ahead/github_ahead/diverged/unlinked state with commit SHAs and pending change counts.

branch.description: Optional branch to check against. Omit to use the instance's tracked branch or repo default.

tools.name: get_sync_status
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to check the GitHub sync status for a strategy instance — shows sync history, open PRs, and last sync result.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the YAML template for a specific EPF artifact to scaffold a new artifact or understand its structure.

path.description: Template path relative to templates root, e.g. READY/00_north_star.yaml

tools.name: get_value_propositions
tools.description: USE WHEN you need a cross-feature view of what value each feature delivers — all features with their contributes_to value paths.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full artifact snapshot from a specific strategy version. Returns all artifacts and relationships at that point in time.

tools.name: get_wizard
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the full wizard instructions for a specific EPF artifact type (legacy format).

tools.name: get_work_package
tools.description: [work] USE WHEN you need the full payload of a single work package.

tools.name: get_work_package_footprint
tools.description: [work] USE WHEN you need a work package's footprint — the collision key for parallel-safe scheduling. Footprint = union of value_model_paths + definition_ids (KRs excluded), derived server-side.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: USE WHEN you need details for a specific workspace by ID.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: USE WHEN you need a health report and artifact completeness summary for an instance.

tools.name: import_from_github
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to import EPF strategy artifacts from the instance's linked GitHub repository. Automatically determines the sync state and takes the safe action: no-op if in sync, refuses if server has unpushed enrichments, creates a safety PR then imports if diverged. Requires github_repo to be set on the instance (use update_instance).

branch.description: Optional branch to import from. Omit to use the instance's tracked branch or the repo's default branch. Specify to switch to a different branch (e.g. 'dev' for a mature product's long-lived dev branch).

tools.name: import_instance
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to create an empty strategy instance in a workspace. Optionally link to a GitHub repo for future sync. Does not fetch artifacts — use CLI import for that.

tools.name: ingest_evidence
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to submit a new structured evidence item (metric, user feedback, sales call, competitive insight, etc.) for strategy assessment. Stores as evidence artifact with tags for filtering.

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when evidence was collected (default: now)

content.description: Evidence content as a JSON object or plain text string

linked_artifacts.description: Comma-separated artifact keys this evidence supports, e.g. 'fd-001,okr-product-1'

source_name.description: Name of the evidence source, e.g. 'Q1 NPS Survey', 'Sales call with Acme'

source_url.description: Optional URL to the source document or recording

tags.description: Comma-separated tags for filtering. Suggested: competitive, partner, technical, market, narrative, metric, user-feedback, sales, support, engineering, internal

tools.name: install_pack
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to install a skill pack into an instance. Provide pack_yaml and an array of skills. Use force: true to upgrade an existing pack.

force.description: Replace existing pack if already installed (default: false)

skills.description: JSON array of {name, skill_yaml, prompt_md?, script_src?, script_lang?}

tools.name: invite_member
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to invite a user to an organisation by email. Requires org_admin role.

tools.name: link_evidence
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to create a relationship between an evidence item and another artifact (feature, OKR, assumption). Creates a strategy_relationship edge.

relationship.description: Relationship type (default: supports). Common: supports, invalidates, validates, contradicts

target_key.description: Target artifact key, e.g. fd-001 or okr-product-1

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the recent activity stream for a strategy instance — shows proposal lifecycle events, cycle starts, evidence ingestion, assessments committed, and heartbeat triggers. Returns newest events first.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1–200, default 50)

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to discover which EPF AI agents are available for orchestrating authoring workflows.

tools.name: list_aim_cycles
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see the history of completed AIM cycles for an instance. Returns cycles ordered by published_at descending, with cycle number, decision, version ID, and timestamp.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see which strategy apps are installed for an instance, including their display metadata and status.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to list strategy artifacts of any type (commercial_def, org_ops_def, strategy_def, value_model, etc.) with their index fields (name, track, status).

artifact_type.description: Filter by artifact type, e.g. commercial_def, org_ops_def, strategy_def, value_model, feature

tools.name: list_consumer_repos
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see which repositories consume a strategy instance (e.g. mount it as a submodule). Does not include the instance's own home repo — that is github_repo on the instance itself.

tools.name: list_cycle_proposals
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see pending AIM cycle proposals for an instance. Proposals are created automatically by the heartbeat when a trigger fires and no cycle is active.

status.description: Filter by status: pending (default), approved, deferred, expired, or all

tools.name: list_definitions
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see all canonical track definition templates (commercial, org_ops, strategy). Optionally filter by track name.

track.description: Filter by track: commercial, org_ops, strategy. Omit for all.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to list evidence items for an instance. Filter by tags, source, processing status, or linked artifact.

linked_artifact.description: Filter to items linked to this artifact key

processing_status.description: Filter by processing status: unprocessed, processed, archived

since.description: ISO 8601 datetime — include only items collected after this date

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to filter by (OR logic)

tools.name: list_features
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the feature list with strategic alignment for an instance.

include_archived.description: Set to "true" to include archived features in the response (default: false).

tools.name: list_github_installations
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to list all GitHub orgs and personal accounts where the GitHub App is installed. This is the entry point for the repo connect flow — call this first to discover which GitHub accounts to scan.

tools.name: list_heartbeat_signals
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see active heartbeat signals — automatic trigger evaluations that fired for an instance, indicating an AIM cycle may be due.

include_acknowledged.description: Set to true to include already-acknowledged signals (default: false)

tools.name: list_installed_skills
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to list all skills available to an instance, with source provenance (installed | canonical | generator-alias). Use source_filter to narrow to installed-only.

source_filter.description: Filter by source: installed | canonical | all (default: all)

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to list strategy instances in a workspace.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see all members and pending invitations for an organisation.

tools.name: list_mutations
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the change history for a strategy instance.

artifact_type.description: Filter by artifact type, e.g. feature

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (mutation ID) from a previous response

tools.name: list_orgs
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see all organisations the caller belongs to.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see which skill packs are installed for an instance and whether the standard pack is up to date.

tools.name: list_pending_batches
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see all staged (uncommitted) batches waiting for human review in an instance.

tools.name: list_relationships
tools.description: USE WHEN you need all cross-artifact relationships (contributes_to, depends_on, tests_assumption, etc.) for a specific artifact key.

artifact_key.description: Artifact key to query relationships for, e.g. fd-001 or FIRE/definitions/commercial/financing/cd-010-investor-pitch-decks

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to discover which EPF artifact schemas are available for validation or authoring guidance.

tools.name: list_signals
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see active ripple signals — misalignments between connected artifacts.

signal_type.description: Filter: drift, propagation, tension, staleness, clustering, orphan

status.description: Filter: active (default), acknowledged, resolved, dismissed, all

tools.name: list_skill_runs
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see autonomous skill execution history for an instance — shows status, timing, token usage, and trigger context.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to discover which EPF skills are available to guide a specific authoring task.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to see all available EPF artifact templates across READY, FIRE, and AIM phases.

tools.name: list_tool_categories
tools.description: USE FIRST to see which tool categories are available and active. Returns categories with tool counts. By default only 'core' tools are visible — use set_tool_filter to activate more.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: USE WHEN you need the version history for a strategy instance. Returns all published, superseded, and restored versions with their metadata.

tools.name: list_wizards
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to discover available legacy EPF wizard files for artifact authoring guidance.

tools.name: list_work_packages
tools.description: [work] USE WHEN you need the work packages for an instance, optionally filtered by track or status.

include_archived.description: Set to "true" to include archived work packages (default: false).

status.description: Filter by status: proposed | approved | scheduled | executing | done | cancelled

track.description: Filter by track: product | strategy | org_ops | commercial

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to enumerate all accessible workspaces.

tools.name: propose_change
tools.description: USE WHEN you want to preview the blast radius of a proposed change before committing.

tools.name: publish_version
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to create a named snapshot of the current strategy state. Captures all artifacts and relationships into an atomic version that can be compared, restored, or synced to GitHub.

description.description: Longer description of what changed or why this version was published

label.description: Short label for this version, e.g. 'Q2 Strategy'

tools.name: register_consumer_repo
tools.description: USE WHEN a repository consumes a strategy instance and should be discoverable by find_instance_by_repo. Use this instead of update_instance when the repo is not the instance's source of truth — update_instance's github_repo is where sync reads from and AIM pushes to. Idempotent.

base_path.description: Path within the consuming repo where the instance is mounted, e.g. docs/EPF/_instances/emergent. Omit for the repo root.

note.description: Optional free-text note, e.g. how the instance is consumed

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to remove a member from an organisation. Requires org_admin role.

tools.name: resolve_signal
tools.description: USE WHEN a signal has been addressed and you want to mark it resolved.

batch_id.description: Optional batch UUID that addressed the signal

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to revert the strategy to a previous version's state. Creates a new version with the restored artifacts and relationships.

tools.name: run_app
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to invoke an installed strategy app. The app receives artifact context and returns a document. If it proposes mutations, a batch_id is returned for human review.

params.description: Optional JSON object forwarded to the app as params

tools.name: run_scenario
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to explore a what-if strategy branch without committing to main. Returns a scenario_id for evaluation.

anchor_node.description: Optional artifact key to anchor the scenario

tools.name: run_skill
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to execute an installed or canonical skill. Prompt-mode skills return the prompt for you to follow. Script-mode skills run a subprocess and return the output.

mode.description: Execution mode: interactive (default) or autonomous. Autonomous mode calls the LLM server-side and stages mutations.

params.description: Optional JSON object passed to the skill as params

tools.name: scaffold_instance
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to create a new strategy instance with template artifacts pre-populated. Creates the instance with all READY-phase artifacts (north star, foundations, formula, roadmap, insights) seeded from canonical templates, giving the user a starting point to fill in rather than a blank slate.

tools.name: scaffold_skill
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to generate a schema-valid skill.yaml, prompt.md, and pack.yaml skeleton for a new skill. Output is ready to pass directly to install_pack.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the skill does

phase.description: EPF phase: READY | FIRE | AIM (default: FIRE)

requires_artifacts.description: Comma-separated artifact types the skill requires

requires_tools.description: Comma-separated MCP tool names the skill uses

script_lang.description: Script language (script mode only): py | sh | ts | js (default: sh)

type.description: Skill type: creation | review | generation | analysis

tools.name: scan_github_repos
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to scan all repositories for a GitHub owner (org or personal account) and detect which contain EPF strategy instances. Returns a repo list with EPF detection results. Results are cached for 5 minutes. Use list_github_installations to discover valid owner values first.

github_owner.description: GitHub organisation login or personal account login, e.g. 'acme-company' or 'nikolaifasting'.

tools.name: search_strategy
tools.description: USE WHEN you need semantic search across the strategy graph for an instance.

tools.name: set_tool_filter
tools.description: USE WHEN you need tools from a specific category. Activates tool categories so they appear in tools/list. Pass category names from list_tool_categories. The 'core' category is always active. Pass 'all' to show every tool.

categories.description: Category names to activate, e.g. ["features", "aim"]. Use ["all"] to show all tools.

tools.name: stage_artifact
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to stage any EPF artifact type that doesn't have a dedicated write tool (e.g. org_ops_def, commercial_def, strategy_def, insight_opportunity, mappings). Returns batch_id for confirmation.

action.description: Mutation action: create, update, or archive

artifact_type.description: EPF artifact type, e.g. commercial_def, org_ops_def, strategy_def, value_model

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: stage_calibration
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to stage a calibration memo after an AIM review. Captures strategic adjustments and lessons learned. Stages a mutation; call commit_batch after review.

batch_id.description: Optional batch UUID to group with other staged mutations

payload.description: Calibration memo JSON payload conforming to calibration_memo_schema

tools.name: suggest_relationships
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to identify missing cross-artifact relationships for a feature — checks value model coverage, assumption testing, and dependency gaps.

tools.name: sync_to_github
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to push strategy artifacts to a GitHub repository as a pull request. Exports all artifacts as YAML files and creates a PR for review. Requires a GitHub App installation on the target org.

version_id.description: Optional version UUID. If omitted, syncs the current working state (draft sync).

tools.name: transition_work_package
tools.description: [work] USE WHEN you need to move a work package to a new status. Enforces the state-machine: proposed → approved → scheduled → executing → done (+ cancelled from any non-terminal). Illegal transitions are rejected. Returns batch_id.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

to_status.description: Target status: approved | scheduled | executing | done | cancelled

tools.name: uninstall_pack
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to remove an installed pack and all its skills and apps from an instance.

tools.name: unregister_consumer_repo
tools.description: USE WHEN a repository no longer consumes a strategy instance and should stop appearing in find_instance_by_repo.

base_path.description: Mount path used when the link was registered. Omit if it was registered at the repo root.

tools.name: update_evidence
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to update an existing evidence item — e.g. add tags, update summary, or link to additional artifacts.

linked_artifacts.description: Updated comma-separated linked artifact keys (replaces existing)

tools.name: update_feature
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft an update to an existing feature. Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: update_insight_analyses
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft an update to the insight analyses artifact (competitive landscape, market trends). Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: update_instance
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to configure or update the GitHub repository link for a strategy instance. Sets github_repo (owner/repo slug) and optionally github_base_path. Required before import_from_github or sync_to_github if not already set.

github_base_path.description: Optional path prefix within the repo where EPF artifacts live, e.g. 'docs/epf'. Leave empty to use the repo root.

github_repo.description: GitHub repository slug in owner/repo format, e.g. 'my-org/strategy'. Clear by setting to empty string.

tools.name: update_lra
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to update an existing LRA artifact — e.g. to revise findings or update strategic alignment. Stages a mutation; call commit_batch after review.

batch_id.description: Optional batch UUID

tools.name: update_north_star
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft a north star vision change. Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: update_org
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to update organisation metadata (name, website, org number). Requires org_admin role.

tools.name: update_ripple_config
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to update ripple thresholds for an instance.

config.description: JSON ripple config (partial updates merged with existing)

tools.name: update_roadmap
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft an update to the roadmap recipe artifact (phased feature delivery plan). Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: update_strategy_formula
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft an update to the strategy formula artifact (vision, bets, OKRs). Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: update_strategy_foundations
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft an update to the strategy foundations artifact (personas, positioning, ICP). Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: update_value_model
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to draft an update to a value model artifact for a specific track (product, commercial, org_ops). Returns batch_id for confirmation.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

track.description: Value model track, e.g. product, commercial, org_ops

tools.name: update_work_package
tools.description: [work] USE WHEN you need to draft an update to an existing work package. For status changes prefer transition_work_package. Returns batch_id.

batch_id.description: Existing batch UUID to append to

tools.name: validate_artifact
tools.description: USE WHEN you want to validate a JSON artifact payload against its EPF schema. Auto-detects the artifact type when not provided. Returns a verdict in structuredContent: `ok` is true when there are no errors, and `findings` enumerates every problem so you can apply your own threshold. Finding problems is a successful call, not an error.

artifact_type.description: EPF artifact type (e.g. feature, north_star). Auto-detected when omitted.

payload.description: JSON payload of the artifact to validate

tools.name: validate_assumptions
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to check which strategic assumptions have features testing them and which are untested. Returns assumption coverage with risk assessment.

tools.name: validate_instance
tools.description: USE WHEN you need a full validation report for all artifacts in a strategy instance — schema validation for each artifact type. Returns a verdict in structuredContent. NOTE: `ok` is false whenever any artifact is invalid, so on an instance with a tolerated backlog it is false on every call and carries no signal — gate on `findings` (each has a stable key/rule/path) rather than on `ok`.

tools.name: validate_relationships
tools.description: USE WHEN you need to check cross-artifact reference integrity — verifies that relationship target_keys resolve to actual artifacts in strategy_artifacts. Returns a verdict in structuredContent; each broken reference is one finding keyed by its source artifact.

tools.name: validate_with_plan
tools.description: USE WHEN you have a large number of validation errors and need a prioritized fix plan. Validates all artifacts in an instance and groups errors by severity with suggested fix order. Returns a verdict in structuredContent; the prioritised fix plan itself stays in the text content.

artifacts.description: Strategy calibration memo after AIM review
